name: fo-cross-border-payments
description: Check Faroese cross-border payments, domestic permanent-establishment exposure and securities migration in 2026. Prepare royalty and dividend withholding, gross-to-net calculations, payment and information deadlines, treaty-refund evidence and the dividend-refund practice introduced on 1 May. Distinguish full residence from limited domestic-source liability and test the special construction-project rule before applying a treaty. Identify individual securities exit tax, deferral documents, continuing reports and immigration basis. Use for Faroese royalties, dividend tax refunds, foreign contractors, PE screening, moving abroad with shares and inbound investment portfolios. Treaty-specific rates, complex PE profit attribution, company migration, complete exit-deferral adjustments and complex foreign-tax credit cases need additional source work. Independent AI review accepted partial draft publication; professional attestation remains pending.
